topic: how almost all of Nvidia revenue now comes from data centers
storyAngle: Nvidia started as a graphics company for gamers; now one business makes nearly everything.
doNotClaim: Fiscal 2025 means the year ended in late January 2025.
These are revenue figures, not profit.
Do not say gaming is small or declining.

facts.claim: Nvidia fiscal 2025 total revenue was $130,497 million.
say: one hundred thirty point five billion dollars

facts.claim: Nvidia fiscal 2025 Data Center revenue was $115.2 billion, up 142% from a year earlier.
say: one hundred fifteen point two billion dollars

derived.claim: Data Center was about 88% of Nvidia fiscal 2025 revenue (115.2 / 130.5): nearly nine dollars in every ten.
